name: Remembrance
source:
Based on a poem written for the Trans Day of Remembrance 2022, Remembrance is a short interactive poem about remembering those who are gone.

[Edited from [url=https://kuismai.itch.io/remembrance]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《纪念》改编自一首为2022年跨性别纪念日创作的诗歌，是一首关于纪念逝去之人的互动短诗。
